name: Jallarzi's Storm of Radiance

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

upcast.text: The Radiant and the Thunder damage each increase by 1d10 per slot level above 5.

summary: A 10-foot-radius storm of light and thunder: Con save, 2d10 Radiant plus 2d10 Thunder, half on a success.
text: Creatures inside are Blinded and Deafened and can't cast spells with a Verbal component. They save when it appears and when they enter it or end a turn there, once per turn.
